responsibility: Exposes the module's slice-search helper for treating a sorted slice as a multimap keyed by a derived value, returning the contiguous subslice whose elements match a requested key by locating the lower and upper key bounds.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `mod.rs` files, this is a tiny helper module centered on one slice-search routine over already-sorted data; it is not a facade or a full data-structure/graph subsystem.
